title: BUGFIX — Gate display counts include dry-run posts in /posted and /updateviews
rationale: cmdPosted() uses readLines(manualPostsPath).length for gate display (shows 17 including 3 dry-runs). cmdUpdateViews() same issue. Both should use readRealPosts() which filters dry-runs. Fix ensures gate display matches actual gate progress.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts cmdPosted(): replace `readLines(manualPostsPath)` with `readRealPosts()` for gate display. In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-management.ts cmdUpdateViews(): same fix.
